_comment: Loading tips + trivia + general tips. FF names/lore are placeholders; tip text is original.

playingTips: Angle Shield of Light toward the enemy's biggest damage source.
Vanguard Step onto an ally to reposition, or onto an enemy to knock them off your carry.
Pop Shining Bulwark before you dive so the field and marks are live.
playingAgainstTips: Bait Shield of Light before committing burst; it heavily reduces frontal damage.
Spread out against Shining Bulwark so its field covers fewer allies.
trivia: The Warriors of Light bore the crystals in the world's oldest recorded conflict.
In the arena he answers the call of Cosmos, the embodiment of order.

playingTips: Open Chain of Ruin, recast to lunge, then Greatblade Reap to clump the group.
Iron Advance is unstoppable during wind-up; punch through crowd control with it.
Cycle of Strife rewards long fights; pick your moments against hit-and-run foes.
playingAgainstTips: Kite Garland with slows; his stacks decay when he can't keep swinging.
Don't clump against Greatblade Reap; the edge drags you back in.
trivia: Garland is bound to a loop that resurrects him across the ages.
A servant of Chaos, he revels in a battle that never truly ends.

playingTips: Weave weapons: Spearline into Bow Volley into Blood Blade keeps Arsenal Rhythm stacked.
Bow Volley reveals; use it to check brush before rotating.
Aim Wild Rose Arsenal's final shot at a low-health target.
playingAgainstTips: Firion is combo-dependent; interrupt his rhythm and his damage falls off.
Punish him when he steps in for Blood Blade.
trivia: Firion fights for a rebellion whose symbol is the wild rose.
He is famed for mastering every weapon he picks up.

playingTips: Pre-place Hell Snare in brush where it's hardest to see.
Trigger two separate traps to apply Exposed and open a burst window.
Imperial Repulse can shove a diver back onto your Thunder Sigil.
playingAgainstTips: The Emperor is weak without setup; dive before his traps are placed.
Avoid stacking hazards; two traps make you Exposed.
trivia: The Emperor of Palamecia conquered through cunning and dark sorcery.
He is ambitious enough to claim both Heaven and Hell.

playingTips: In Ninja stance, Swift Blade resets on a marked target.
Swap to Sage before Dualcast for the empowered bolts, then swap back to escape.
Job Mastery rewards alternating physical then magical casts.
playingAgainstTips: Bully Onion Knight early; he spikes late and is squishy.
Watch his stance colour; a mistimed Job Shift wastes his combo.
trivia: A gifted youth whose strength blossoms when others underestimate him.
The crystals let him master any job they reveal.

playingTips: Land Zero Ray at max range to stack Void without stepping up.
Dark Flood zones a chokepoint and slows dives.
Save Unbound Form to dodge the key engage; you can't cast during it.
playingAgainstTips: Collapse on Cloud of Darkness; she is immobile.
Break her vision to deny the Void ramp.
trivia: The embodiment of the Void, existing only to return all to nothing.
She is neither cruel nor kind, simply the end of creation.

playingTips: Farm in Dark Knight to fill the Light gauge, then Redemption into Paladin.
Cover leaps to shield a diving ally; time it for the enemy burst.
Don't sit in Dark Knight at low health; the self-damage adds up.
playingAgainstTips: Force Cecil to commit a stance; he's weakest with the wrong tool.
Punish greedy Dark Knight play; his abilities cost health.
trivia: A Dark Knight who climbed Mount Ordeals to be reborn as a Paladin.
Both his past and his redemption live within him.

playingTips: Land Dragon Pin first so the slow guarantees High Jump connects.
You are untargetable while airborne; use it to dodge a key ability.
Vault over walls to reset a chase.
playingAgainstTips: Respect High Jump; spread so his slam hits fewer targets.
Punish a whiffed leap hard on the landing.
trivia: Captain of the Baron Dragoons and Cecil's closest rival.
His spear is said to reach the heavens.

playingTips: Pick your Job Parade loadout to cover your team's gaps.
Match Spellblade Arc's element to the enemy.
Activate Guard Job as you commit to convert damage into speed.
playingAgainstTips: Bartz has no single dominant strength; deny his setup.
His loadout is locked pre-match; scout and plan around it.
trivia: An easygoing wanderer who inherited a promise to protect the crystals.
He mimics the techniques of every hero he meets.

playingTips: Hold ground to bank Rooted defenses, then move to unleash stored energy.
Gravity Well into Black Branch drags enemies onto the roots.
Trap foes inside Grand Cross with Gravity Well.
playingAgainstTips: Kite Exdeath; he has almost no mobility.
Bait the long Grand Cross wind-up.
trivia: An ancient tree that absorbed centuries of sealed evil into armored form.
He seeks to consume all existence into the Great Void.

generalTips: The three elemental summons are revealed at match start; plan objective timings around them.
Odin only unlocks after all three elemental trials are resolved.
Ward the river before contesting the Rift of the Gods.
Boots take the dedicated 6th slot; your other five are for items.
Bought an item by mistake? Undo it for a full refund within the grace window.
Selling returns 60% of an item's cost; undo returns 100% right after buying.
A champion-exclusive item only appears while that champion is locked in.
Last-hitting the objective grants its blessing to your whole team.
Danger telegraphs stay visible even on reduced-effects settings.
Destroying a lane seal spawns a Goblin Warlord to help you push.
Recall at the fountain to restock consumables between fights.
Divine manifestations rotate with no immediate repeat; the next is previewed.
